info.brief: A Defold extension for advanced window features on Windows. Custom window shapes, window transparency, lock aspect ratio for resize, hook for custom function of close button, and flashing of the taskbar button.
info.description: A Defold extension for advanced window features on Windows. Custom window shapes, window transparency, lock aspect ratio for resize, hook for custom function of close button, and flashing of the taskbar button.

elements.name: defwin.set_alpha_color
elements.description: Set which color should be rendered transparent by the window, and removes the window border. The transparent areas will also be click-through.

parameters.name: r
parameters.doc: Red component in [0.0, 1.0]. If omitted, the render clear color is used.

parameters.name: g
parameters.doc: Green component in [0.0, 1.0].

parameters.name: b
parameters.doc: Blue component in [0.0, 1.0].

elements.name: defwin.set_image_buffer
elements.description: Use an image instead of the default window contents, with pixels outside the image left transparent.

parameters.name: bytes_string
parameters.doc: Raw RGBA pixel data, e.g. from buffer.get_bytes(buf, hash("rgba"))

parameters.name: width
parameters.doc: Width of the image buffer in pixels

parameters.name: height
parameters.doc: Height of the image buffer in pixels

parameters.name: flip
parameters.doc: If true, the rows are flipped vertically (default false)

returnvalues.name: success
returnvalues.doc: true if the image buffer was applied successfully

elements.name: defwin.set_alpha
elements.description: Set the transparency of the whole window, including the border. Can't be used together with set_alpha_color.

parameters.name: alpha
parameters.doc: Opacity in [0.0, 1.0]. 0.0 = fully transparent, 1.0 = fully opaque.

elements.name: defwin.set_borderless
elements.description: Remove or restore the window border.

parameters.name: enable
parameters.doc: true to remove the window border, false to restore it

elements.name: defwin.reset_alpha
elements.description: Remove the window transparency, restoring the original opaque window.

elements.name: defwin.set_close_listener
elements.description: Set a listener that is called instead of quitting the game when the close button is pressed.

parameters.name: listener
parameters.doc: Called when a close is requested. Pass nil to clear the listener and restore default close behaviour.

elements.name: defwin.set_close_delay
elements.description: Set the time after a close request until the game exits automatically.

parameters.name: delay
parameters.doc: Time in seconds before the game exits. 0 closes as soon as the close button is pressed. Pass nil for no automatic close, leaving the close listener fully in control.

elements.name: defwin.set_close_sound_fadeout
elements.description: If enabled and a close delay is set, the master sound group gain is faded out over the delay duration until shutdown.

parameters.name: enable
parameters.doc: true to enable the sound fade-out on close

elements.name: defwin.quit
elements.description: Quit the game, respecting the configured close delay and sound fade-out settings.

elements.name: defwin.request_quit
elements.description: Request to quit the game, behaving as if the user pressed the close button or Alt+F4. Triggers the close listener and delay handling.

elements.name: defwin.cancel_close
elements.description: Cancel an in-progress close attempt. Until this is called again on a future close, further attempts to close the window will not re-trigger the listener or restart the delay.

elements.name: defwin.set_dark_mode
elements.description: Set the window border style to dark mode or light mode.

parameters.name: enable
parameters.doc: Set to dark mode on true, and to light mode on false

elements.name: defwin.get_dark_mode_preference
elements.description: Get the preference of the current user for dark mode or light mode.

returnvalues.name: preference
returnvalues.doc: ´true´ if dark mode is preferred, ´false´ if light mode is preferred, and ´nil´ if the preference is unknown

elements.name: defwin.set_corners_rounded
elements.description: Set the corner style of the window frame to rounded, if available.

elements.name: defwin.set_corners_rounded_small
elements.description: Set the corner style of the window frame to slightly rounded, if available.

elements.name: defwin.set_corners_not_rounded
elements.description: Set the corner style of the window frame to not rounded.

elements.name: defwin.set_corners_default
elements.description: Set the corner style of the window frame to the default.

elements.name: defwin.set_border_color
elements.description: Set window border color.

parameters.name: r
parameters.doc: Red component in [0.0, 1.0]. If omitted, the default color is used.

parameters.name: g
parameters.doc: Green component in [0.0, 1.0].

parameters.name: b
parameters.doc: Blue component in [0.0, 1.0].

elements.name: defwin.set_border_color_none
elements.description: Set the window border color to be transparent.

elements.name: defwin.set_caption_color
elements.description: Set window caption color.

parameters.name: r
parameters.doc: Red component in [0.0, 1.0]. If omitted, the default color is used.

parameters.name: g
parameters.doc: Green component in [0.0, 1.0].

parameters.name: b
parameters.doc: Blue component in [0.0, 1.0].

elements.name: defwin.set_caption_text_color
elements.description: Set window caption text color.

parameters.name: r
parameters.doc: Red component in [0.0, 1.0]. If omitted, the default color is used.

parameters.name: g
parameters.doc: Green component in [0.0, 1.0].

parameters.name: b
parameters.doc: Blue component in [0.0, 1.0].

elements.name: defwin.get_caption_color
elements.description: Get the opaque color of the window caption.

returnvalues.name: color
returnvalues.doc: (r, g, b, 1) with r, g, b in [0.0, 1.0]

elements.name: defwin.set_rtl_layout
elements.description: Set window bar layout to right-to-left, affecting buttons, title, and icon.

parameters.name: enable
parameters.doc: Set window to RTL layout on true, and to LTR layout on false

elements.name: defwin.set_tool_window
elements.description: Turns the window into a tool window. Tool windows are not shown on taskbar and Alt-Tab, and have no minimize and maximize buttons or icon.

parameters.name: enable
parameters.doc: Set to tool window on true, and back to normal window on false

elements.name: defwin.lock_ratio
elements.description: Lock the aspect ratio of the window when the user drags its border.

parameters.name: ratio
parameters.doc: The aspect ratio to lock (width / height). If omitted, the aspect ratio of the default resolution in game.project is used.

elements.name: defwin.unlock_ratio
elements.description: Remove the aspect ratio lock set by lock_ratio.

elements.name: defwin.set_minimum_window_size
elements.description: Set the minimum size a window is allowed to have when resized.

parameters.name: width
parameters.doc: Minimum width in pixels.

parameters.name: height
parameters.doc: Minimum height in pixels.

elements.name: defwin.fit_vertical
elements.description: Fit the window to the given aspect ratio by resizing only the height.

parameters.name: ratio
parameters.doc: The aspect ratio to fit to (width / height). If omitted, the aspect ratio from the display size in game.project is used.

elements.name: defwin.fit_horizontal
elements.description: Fit the window to the given aspect ratio by resizing only the width.

parameters.name: ratio
parameters.doc: The aspect ratio to fit to (width / height). If omitted, the aspect ratio from the display size in game.project is used.

elements.name: defwin.fit_grow
elements.description: Fit the window to the given aspect ratio by only growing the size in one direction.

parameters.name: ratio
parameters.doc: The aspect ratio to fit to (width / height). If omitted, the aspect ratio from the display size in game.project is used.

elements.name: defwin.fit_shrink
elements.description: Fit the window to the given aspect ratio by only shrinking the size in one direction.

parameters.name: ratio
parameters.doc: The aspect ratio to fit to (width / height). If omitted, the aspect ratio from the display size in game.project is used.

elements.name: defwin.fit_screen
elements.description: Reposition and resize the window so that no part of it is outside of the screen.

elements.name: defwin.flash
elements.description: Flash the window a limited number of times.

parameters.name: taskbar
parameters.doc: Should the taskbar button flash

parameters.name: caption
parameters.doc: Should the window caption flash

parameters.name: count
parameters.doc: How many times to flash (default 1)

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.doc: Time between flashes, in seconds (default platform cursor blink rate)

elements.name: defwin.start_flash
elements.description: Start flashing the window until manually stopped or until the window regains focus.

parameters.name: taskbar
parameters.doc: Should the taskbar button flash

parameters.name: caption
parameters.doc: Should the window caption flash

parameters.name: until_focused
parameters.doc: If true, focusing the window stops the flash. If false, it flashes until stop_flash() is called.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.doc: Time between flashes, in seconds (default platform cursor blink rate)

elements.name: defwin.stop_flash
elements.description: Stop the window from flashing. As the current flash cycle still completes, it can take a few seconds to disappear.

elements.name: defwin.set_progress
elements.description: Set the progress bar on the taskbar button.

parameters.name: value
parameters.doc: Progress in [0.0, 1.0]

elements.name: defwin.set_progress_error
elements.description: Set the progress bar on the taskbar button to an error state, turning it red.

elements.name: defwin.set_progress_load
elements.description: Set the progress bar on the taskbar button to an indeterminate loading state.

elements.name: defwin.pause_progress
elements.description: Pauses the progress bar on the taskbar button, turning it yellow until a new value or state is set.

elements.name: defwin.hide_progress
elements.description: Hide the progress bar on the taskbar button, until a new value or state is set.

elements.name: defwin.start_drag
elements.description: Start dragging the window along the cursor. Must be paired with repeated calls to update_drag() to have any effect.

elements.name: defwin.update_drag
elements.description: Update one frame of the window drag started with start_drag(). Should be called every frame (e.g. from an on_input or update callback) while dragging is active.

elements.name: defwin.stop_drag
elements.description: Stop dragging the window along the cursor.

elements.name: defwin.prevent_sleep
elements.description: Keep the window active to prevent the system from going to sleep while enabled.

parameters.name: enable
parameters.doc: Prevent sleep if true, let system handle activity on false
